title: Exponential Backoff for Payment Webhooks
lesson: Retry logic is not optional in emerging markets — networks fail constantly.

title: USSD Session State Without a Database
lesson: Redis TTL is the perfect model for USSD sessions — 90 seconds and done.
description: Explored managing USSD session state purely in Redis with a 90-second TTL. No persistent storage. Session data lives only as long as the session, which matches USSD's stateless-by-nature model perfectly.

title: OTP Flood Prevention on SMS-Limited Budget
lesson: Rate limiting OTP sends per phone number saved ~40% on SMS costs immediately.
description: Implemented tiered rate limiting: 3 OTPs per phone per 10 minutes, 10 per hour. Combined with a CAPTCHA-less proof-of-work on the frontend to reduce bot-driven floods.
